parakeet: Because atheism is nothing more than a proposition. Yes, but atheists are people. And people are enough reason to organize. People are enough reason to unify. People are enough reason to build community. People are enough reason to imagine more than critique. If you cannot understand that, if you cannot grasp that human beings are worth gathering for, worth building for, worth protecting and nurturing, then all you are is an atheist. Nothing more, no vision, no ethic, no commitment to the world you live in. And I pity you for it. The future of secular life cannot be built on reaction, arrogance, or antagonism. It must be rooted in humanism, community, global awareness, and secular ethics. The question before us is no longer does God exist? Why are we even wasting time with that? The question now is what do we build now that we no longer believe? And it is in answering that question, not the old ones, that the next chapter of secular life will be written.
